scope: Verification of controlled search/page replay, live engine monitoring, live merchant experiments, actual purchase measurement and optimization/deployment competition.
summary: Controlled search/page responses are implementable for an agent we operate using public function tools.
Synthetic commerce testing, live catalogue experiments, deployment loops and generic replay already have direct or adjacent competitors.
No reviewed public source establishes exact reproduction of consumer ChatGPT private retrieval, ranking, personalization and checkout orchestration through public model APIs.
The economic hypothesis is better selection of deployable edits followed by measured incremental retained purchases, not novelty of the software loop.
No prototype, paid API experiment, merchant change or real purchase was executed in this research.

statusDefinitions.limited_claim: Marketing-only, preview/early access, incomplete implementation detail, historical availability, or a related capability that does not establish the full requested one.
statusDefinitions.not_found: No supporting documentation was found in the reviewed sources. This is an evidence gap, not proof that the capability is absent.

buildSpecification.deliverable: All assigned-unit outcomes, observed-AI-origin subset and unknown origin separately; category/store displacement checks.

buildSpecification.deliverable: Simulated, live-channel and purchase outcomes distinguished; intervals, unit counts, propagation, cost and deploy/continue/reject decision.

claimsAudit.verdict: Invented illustrative values in supplied conversation; no measurement or forecast.
claimsAudit.reason: Several percentages cannot be unweighted binary rates from exactly 50 trials; marginal effects and interactions not measured.
A custom agent's simulated rate is not consumer ChatGPT rate; no calibration or deployment/purchase evidence supplied.
Repeats estimate conditional model variation, not independent humans or intent families.
An exogenous rank change is not a deployable ranking intervention or proof of earned position.
Denominators and stage nesting are unspecified; recommendation/citation/rank are not completed payments.

assumptions: No cluster design effect, attrition, multiplicity or delayed-outcome inflation.
powerIllustration.limitation: Not a product-cluster power calculation; synthetic repetitions do not supply live purchase observations.

validationGates: Replay detects planted factual/variant errors with low false-positive rates.
Held-out offline predictions rank deployable interventions better than simple factual audit and relevant existing workflow.
Production adoption is observed before assigning a channel response to the edit.
Live effect and uncertainty survive prespecified unit-level analysis and displacement/refund checks.
Incremental retained purchase value exceeds implementation, experiment, support and operating cost.
falsifiers: Offline winners do not outperform cheap baselines on held-out live interventions.
Apparent improvements disappear on unseen merchants, models or later time windows.
Selection/attribution gains are substitution from existing purchases rather than net gain.
Merchant volume or assignment access cannot support the intended purchase claim.
Deployment or manual operational cost eliminates the benefit.
